title: #117 After-class Activities

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph focuses on the positive point: that after-class activities help students learn new things and develop skills.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph focuses on the positive point: that after-class activities help students learn new things and develop skills.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph focuses on the negative point: that too many activities can take up too much time and cause tiredness.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph focuses on the negative point: that too many activities can take up too much time and cause tiredness.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point is that these activities can help students learn new things and develop useful skills, such as through sports or music.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point is that these activities can help students learn new things and develop useful skills, such as through sports or music.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: However, the second point is that these activities can take up too much of a student's time, leading to fatigue and less time for friends.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: However, the second point is that these activities can take up too much of a student's time, leading to fatigue and less time for friends.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point argues that after-class activities are beneficial because they give students chances to practice skills outside of normal lessons, thereby boosting their abilities and confidence.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point argues that after-class activities are beneficial because they give students chances to practice skills outside of normal lessons, thereby boosting their abilities and confidence.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: However, the second point warns that these activities can negatively impact students if the workload is too heavy, leaving little time for rest or family.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: However, the second point warns that these activities can negatively impact students if the workload is too heavy, leaving little time for rest or family.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The primary advantage of after-class activities is that they help students develop important skills.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The main disadvantage of these activities is that they can take up too much time and energy, causing a negative impact.

modelPlan.focus: evaluate the benefits and drawbacks of after-class activities for students, providing a balanced perspective.
keyArguments: After-class activities can enhance skill development and social interaction.
